<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def orng(fr):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='O':
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            return (min(rs),min(cs))
    return None
def pegs(fr):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in 'Ng':
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            out.append((n['color'],min(rs),min(cs)))
    return sorted(out)
print('start O',orng(current_frame),'pegs',pegs(current_frame))
for mv in ['RIGHT','RIGHT','RIGHT','RIGHT','RIGHT','RIGHT','RIGHT','RIGHT']:
    action([mv])
    print(mv,'O',orng(current_frame),'pegs',pegs(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def orng(fr):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='O':
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            return (min(rs),min(cs))

def pegs(fr):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in 'Ng':
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            out.append((n['color'],min(rs),min(cs)))
    return sorted(out)
